thread:
Maya R.: Pushed a draft dashboard that correlates GPU sensor streams (SM occupancy, VRAM, power, temp, MIG slice usage) with token-level latency and KV cache hit rate. Pls eyeball before I wire alerts. https://dash.redwood.local/d/abc123/gpu-sensor-correlation

Devon C.: Nice. Does it show the per-route breakdown (api/chat vs api/embeddings)?

Maya R.: Yes — there's a dropdown for route. Default is all routes; opens with route="/v1/chat/completions". Also added a small table with p50/p95/p99 token-latency per-model.

Lucas: Quick note — the kernel selector flag we rolled yesterday can change SM occupancy distribution. We should add a toggle that overlays kernel version to avoid false positives.

Maya R.: good call. I'll add a legend with kernel: {fast-attn-v2, aten-opt, fallback}.

Anika: I'm seeing a cluster-wide pattern where VRAM climbs steadily and KV cache hit rate dips ~5% at the same time p95 token-latency spikes. Suspect prefetch thrash on long sequences. Attached a tiny trace from one pod.

Anika: ```
# pod trace snippet
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z pod-rt-02 token 512 start kernel=fast-attn-v2 sm=0.72 vram=12.6GB kv_hit=0.83
2026-03-18T14:12:05Z pod-rt-02 token 1024 kernel=fallback sm=0.65 vram=12.9GB kv_hit=0.78
```

Maya R.: Thanks — I added a small panel that computes correlation coefficient between kv_hit and p95 across 1h window. Current rolling r = -0.42 for that route.

Devon C.: Can you paste the PromQL for token-level latency breakdown? Want to add it to the perf runbook.

Maya R.: ```promql
# token-level latency breakdown (per model, per route)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))
```

Maya R.: And SM occupancy aggregated by GPU + kernel:
```promql
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_sm_occupancy{pod=~"rt-.*",kernel!=""}[5m]) by (gpu_index,kernel)
```

Lucas: For alerting, suggest combining conditions: p95_token_latency > 1.2s AND avg_gpu_power > 200W OR kv_hit_rate drops > 6pt. Otherwise noisy.

Maya R.: Agreed. I'll propose a composite alert rule: severity=page if p95>1.2s && (pvram>85% || kv_hit_drop>6). Otherwise ticket to infra.

dash-bot: Alert rule draft created: GPU_CORR_HEATMAP_HIGH_LATENCY (draft). Users: @Maya R., @Devon C..

infra-oncall: @Maya R. please add MIG slice metadata. Right now the dashboard rolls up across slices and hides contention. Also include device temp thresholds per instance type (A100 vs H100).

Maya R.: Will add MIG labels and a split view for instance type. Also will add a small note in the panel about known kernel-version regressions (tickets: #INF-3142, #SERV-522).

Devon C.: Can we get a quick runbook snippet for oncall? e.g., steps to reproduce and quick mitigation (model fallback to quantized variant + flush kv cache).

Maya R.: Drafting runbook: 1) Identify impacted route in dashboard; 2) check kernel overlay and MIG usage; 3) run `kubectl exec -it pod -- /bin/sh -c "redis-cli flushdb"` on kv-cache pod if kv_hit<0.6; 4) switch route to fallback model via router API `POST /admin/route/oncall-override` with body `{model: "gptx-lite-q4"}`; 5) rollback kernel flag if recent change.

Anika: FYI, I reproduced the regression locally with long sequences + prefetch enabled. Patch idea: limit prefetch concurrency per-pod to 2. Will open a PR.

Maya R.: Awesome. Once PR lands, I'll add a small histogram comparison panel (prefetch-concurrency=2 vs default) to validate.

Lucas: Minor UX request: add a compact sparkline column in the per-route table for last 10m p95 so SREs can scan fast.

Maya R.: On it. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

infra-oncall: After alerts go live, please add an automated link in the alert to the kube pod logs (`/logs?pod={{pod}}&since=15m`) so page responders have context.

Maya R.: Good idea — linking logs and a small perf trace upload (s3 link) in the alert body. Will follow up with the alert policy PR.

Devon C.: LGTM — approve enabling the dashboard and the alert draft once the MIG labels and kernel overlay are in.

Maya R.: Will merge dashboard + alert draft after updates. Leaving this thread open for a few hours for last comments.

Anika: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infraproj/prefetch-limit PR #889, added test against long-seq perf.

Maya R.: Thx — will smoke test end-to-end after deploy.
